values.note: Two loops in pinon pine: one for tents (11 sites), one with RV spurs (25 in the recreation.gov catalog, 7 of them pull-throughs) that BLM says take vehicles up to about 50 ft. Plus a group tent site and a host site.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/zapata-falls-campground ('Parking spurs on the second loop vary a little in length but in general can handle RVs, towed campers, or other configurations of vehicles up to about 50 feet long.'; 'The sites on one loop are designed for tent campers.') + recreation.gov catalog (25 'RV NONELECTRIC' + 11 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' overnight sites; driveway lengths 27-100 ft; 7 'Pull-through'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Six vault toilets, trash bins, food storage lockers. No drinking water: bring plenty. Good cell service.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/zapata-falls-campground ('No public drinking water system.'; '6 vault (or pit-type) toilets.'; 'Trash bins throughout campground and day-use areas.'; 'food storage locker'; 'Cell phone service is good.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261715 ('There is currently no drinking water in the campground or day-use area. Bring plenty of water'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261715/rates (PeakRVSite 11, PeakTentSite 11, PeakGroupSite 20; off-peak the same; 2026-2028 tables), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/zapata-falls-campground ('All facilities open year-round.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261715/rates (peak Apr 1 - Oct 31, off-peak Nov 1 - Mar 31, same prices), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservations on recreation.gov. Check-in after 1 pm, check-out by noon; a no-show's site is released at 1 pm the next day.

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/zapata-falls-campground ('Make your reservation today at recreation.gov') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261715 (catalog: all 36 overnight sites reservable; notice 'Check-in time is after 1:00 p.m. ... Check-out time is no later than 12:00 p.m. ... If the reservation holder doesn't show up on the first day of the reservation, the campsite is released at check-in time (1 pm) the next day.'), read 2026-10-28

note: BLM campground at ~9,000 ft on the Sangre de Cristo slope above the San Luis Valley, looking out over Great Sand Dunes. Off CO-150 between mile markers 10 and 11 (5 miles south of the national park, 10.5 miles north of US-160), 3.5 miles up an unpaved road, gravel throughout; recreation.gov (October 2026): the road is being upgraded, expect minor delays. Half-mile trail from the day-use area to Zapata Falls (wading required to see it); South Zapata Creek Trail into the Sangre de Cristo Wilderness. --Claude
